description: Load extension in Chrome with the Manifest V3 manifest.
expected: Extension loads without manifest errors.
actual: The unpacked Manifest V3 extension loaded, its service worker started (id gibdglopaedibbjnmacgkkjhicdnfbge) and no manifest errors were reported.

description: Open a target page with candidate elements.
expected: Content script runs and extracts candidates with text, DOM path and style.
actual: The content script ran on demo/dark-checkout.html and extracted 23 visible candidates, each with text and a DOM path; computed style (colour, background, size, visibility) was read by the rules and is not exported.

description: Open a non-target page.
expected: Content script does not run outside declared host patterns.
actual: The manifest matches <all_urls>, so every http(s) page is a declared host; the content script ran on a plain non-shop page (tests/pages/f02_plain.html) and did not run on about:blank. No narrower host restriction exists.

description: Element exceeds threshold τ.
expected: Element is outlined and explanation names the CCPA category.
actual: 4 elements were reported above τ = 0.6 and 4 outlines were drawn, each labelled with its CCPA category name and an explanation.

tags: Basket sneaking (CCPA): This paid option was already selected before you touched it. Check whether you want it.
Interface interference (CCPA): This option is much less visible than the alternative next to it.
Confirm shaming (CCPA): The wording of this option may be designed to make you feel bad about declining.
Trick question (CCPA): This wording is confusing (for example a double negative) and may mislead you about your choice.

description: Element below threshold τ.
expected: No highlight is shown.
actual: The button 'Sign in to continue' has forced-action text evidence only (t = 0.9, α = 0.5, c = 0.45 < τ); 0 detections and 0 highlights were shown.

description: Reported detection is logged.
expected: Backend stores record with site, page, category and confidence.
actual: Not applicable: backend not built. Detections are stored locally with chrome.storage.local by the service worker.

description: Dashboard opened for a site with logged detections.
expected: Manipulation Score and per-category counts are displayed.
actual: Not applicable: dashboard not built. The toolbar popup shows the Manipulation Score and the current page's detections instead.

description: Highlighted control is clicked.
expected: Original page behaviour is unchanged.
actual: The highlighted pre-ticked checkbox was clicked: its state changed from True to False, and the element at its centre was the checkbox itself (highlight overlay has pointer-events: none).

description: Content script sends text batch to service worker.
expected: Message received; request forwarded to inference service.
actual: Not applicable: inference service not built. The content script does send its results to the service worker (pg:results message), but there is no inference service to forward text to.

description: Inference service returns confidences.
expected: Vector of 13 category confidences returned for each text.
actual: Not applicable: inference service not built. The local text stand-in (extension/text.js) returns a 13-value confidence vector per text (see TC-L tests).

description: Inference service unavailable.
expected: Extension degrades gracefully; rule-only categories still evaluated; no crash.
actual: No inference service exists; on demo/dark-checkout.html the extension made 0 external requests, raised 0 page errors and still reported 4 detections (basket_sneaking, confirm_shaming, interface_interference, trick_question) from local rules and the text stand-in.

description: Detection sent to backend.
expected: Backend acknowledges and the record appears in the detection log.
actual: Not applicable: backend not built.

description: Crawler and extension capture the same page.
expected: Same candidate set and features recorded by both.
actual: Candidate sets (DOM paths) compared on 3 pages: demo/dark-checkout.html: extension 23, Playwright 23, common 23; demo/fair-checkout.html: extension 19, Playwright 19, common 19; demo/cases/case3_quick_commerce.html: extension 13, Playwright 13, common 13. Features beyond text and DOM path were not compared.

description: Countdown timer that restarts on reload.
expected: High rule confidence for false urgency.
actual: After one reload the timer restarted; false urgency was reported with r = 1 (Timer showed 300s 7s ago; after reload it shows 300s (expected about 293s).).

description: Countdown timer that continues correctly across reloads.
expected: No false-urgency evidence from the timer rule.
actual: The timer counted down from a stored deadline across a reload; 0 false-urgency detections were made.

description: Insurance add-on checkbox checked on load.
expected: High rule confidence for basket sneaking.
actual: The pre-ticked insurance checkbox was reported as basket sneaking with r = 1.

description: Small, low-contrast dismiss link beside large accept button.
expected: Contrast and area gap detected; interface-interference evidence.
actual: Interface interference was reported on the decline link: Decline "no thanks" has contrast 1.54:1 and area 477px²; accept "Yes, upgrade for ₹99" has contrast 6.10:1 and area 7400px² (ratio 15.5).

description: Accept and dismiss buttons of equal size and contrast.
expected: No interface-interference evidence.
actual: With equal accept and decline buttons, 0 interface-interference detections were made.

description: Element present in DOM with opacity 0.
expected: Element identified as hidden.
actual: The opacity:0 button #ghost was listed as hidden and excluded from candidates (hidden list: ['#ghost']).

description: Checkout total higher than product-page price.
expected: Drip-pricing evidence.
actual: On the checkout step the platform fee, absent from the product step, was reported as drip pricing (1 detection).

description: Cancellation path longer than subscription path.
expected: Subscription-trap evidence.
actual: Not implemented: no subscription-trap rule exists (cancellation path length is not measured).

description: Known colour pairs (e.g. black on white).
expected: Contrast ratio equals the WCAG reference value (21:1 for black on white).
actual: In Node, contrastRatio(black, white) = 21.00:1, white on white = 1.00:1 and #777777 on white = 4.48:1.

description: English guilt-inducing dismissal text.
expected: Highest confidence for confirm shaming.
actual: Input "No thanks, I don't want to save money": highest confidence 0.9 for confirm_shaming.

description: Neutral English dismissal text ("No, thanks").
expected: Negative class or low confidence for all categories.
actual: Input "No, thanks": maximum confidence over all 13 categories was 0.

description: Roman-script Hinglish urgency or shaming text.
expected: Appropriate category with confidence reported (Hinglish performance not yet validated).
actual: Outputs: "Jaldi karo, sirf 2 bache hain!" -> false_urgency (0.7); "Nahi, mujhe discount nahi chahiye" -> confirm_shaming (0.85); "Main risk lunga, insurance nahi chahiye" -> confirm_shaming (0.9). These phrases are in the hand-written pattern list; Hinglish performance has not been validated on any dataset.

description: Very long text beyond maximum length.
expected: Text truncated; classification completes without error.
actual: A 5120-character input was truncated to 512 characters and scored without error; the shaming phrase at the end fell outside the window, so the top category was None.

description: Empty or whitespace-only text.
expected: Element skipped or classified as negative.
actual: Empty and whitespace-only inputs returned all-zero vectors (negative); the content script also skips whitespace-only text nodes when extracting candidates.

description: Harmless wording on deceptive layout (pre-checked add-on).
expected: Detected through rule evidence.
actual: The pre-ticked 'Gift wrap ₹49' checkbox was reported as basket sneaking with r = 1, t = 0.

description: Deceptive wording in neutral layout.
expected: Detected through text evidence.
actual: The equal-styled button "No, I'd rather pay full price" was reported as confirm shaming with r = 0, t = 0.9.

description: Forced action needing both signals.
expected: Fused confidence exceeds τ only when both contribute.
actual: Overlay with 'Sign up to continue' wording: 1 forced-action detection (c = 0.95); overlay with neutral wording (rule only): 0; 'Sign up to continue' button without overlay (text only): 0.

description: Ordinary page with no dark patterns.
expected: No elements reported.
actual: On demo/fair-checkout.html 0 elements were reported.

description: Change of αk in configuration.
expected: Fused output changes without code changes.
actual: Changing alpha for confirm shaming from 0 to 1 in a temporary copy of config.json (no other file changed) reduced the detections on demo/dark-checkout.html from 4 to 3.
